persona: Mid-level SME credit analyst at an NBFC with a few gaps
resumeText:
Vikram Reddy | Hyderabad | vikram.reddy@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Credit Analyst - SME Loans, Godavari Finance Ltd (NBFC), Hyderabad (2022 - present)
- Prepare credit appraisal memos for SME loans of Rs 50 lakh to Rs 5 crore.
- Spread three years of financials and run ratio analysis including DSCR and current ratio.
- Review CIBIL commercial reports and bank statements for every proposal.
- Track SMA-1 and SMA-2 accounts each month and flag early warning signals to relationship managers.
- Present proposals to the credit committee with a clear recommendation.

Credit Officer, Krishna Urban Co-operative Bank, Vijayawada (2020 - 2022)
- Appraised working capital and term loan proposals for traders and small manufacturers.

SKILLS
Credit appraisal, Financial analysis, RBI IRAC norms, Advanced Excel

EDUCATION
MBA Finance, Osmania University, Hyderabad, 2020
